notes: Playback no longer sounds uneven when two tracks are almost the same tempo: the beat servo used to flip the browser between straight playback and time-stretching every 200 ms near 1.0x, now it stays on one side. New: Shuffle and Best order (every track once, best transitions, a little different each time) for crates, lists and the queue; drag tracks in the queue, Play next, remove; mix shape and length vary and never repeat the same shape twice in a row; Auto DJ lines up bars and phrases, not only beats (beat one of the bar is measured; Clean up > Refine beatgrids updates old tracks, grids you set by hand are left alone); mixes level-match by loudness; limiter catches fast peaks; the bottom bar is cleaner (Tidal actions in one labelled menu, no overlap in a narrow window).
